title: Egyptian Vegetable Bake
description: A flavorful vegan bake featuring a mix of vegetables and Middle Eastern spices. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: Vibrant vegetables
ingredients.notes: Assorted colorful vegetables like bell peppers, zucchini, and onions

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: Crumbs from a store-bought or homemade bread

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large bowl, toss together the vibrant vegetables, shattering eggplant, and egyptian spices.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the bake crumbs evenly over the top of the vegetables.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
